source.text: I'm planning a trip to Disneyland Resort soon and I was wondering if you could recommend some good places to eat. I'm particularly interested in trying some fried chicken, and I heard the Paradise Garden Grill has a great fried chicken sandwich. By the way, I just ran the Disney Princess Half Marathon there a few weeks ago, it was an amazing experience!
